record_title: Exact Zumkeller partition counts for the family 2^a p
scientific_context: An exact formula and bijection for the number of equal-sum divisor bipartitions of 2^a p, together with complete fixed-multiplicity prime intervals, a limiting prime-parameter law, and an aggregate identity involving omega(n).
limitations: Restricted to the exponent-one two-prime family 2^a p. The k=1 interval was previously recorded in OEIS A083209 and is not claimed as new. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; older informal sequence material and the 2008 Clark et al. announcement were not fully inspected.

artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exact verification of the partition-count formula for 315 bounded (a,p) pairs and of the aggregate omega identity.
Deterministic verification output reporting zero direct-count and aggregate-identity mismatches.
